candidate: A2: soft-stylized silhouette sample (hand-built from primitives)
edits: Every vertex is generated by tools/blender/character/build_commuter_soft.py from rings, eggs and boxes: no body generator (MakeHuman/MPFB/HumGen) and no downloaded mesh is involved

38-joint UE-style contract armature reused from the candidate A build (tools/blender/character/build_commuter_mpfb.py build_armature); joint layout starts from the p0 sample and moves the shoulders to 0.376 m span, the head pivot to 1.53 m and the arms to hang at the sides

Proportions 6.20 heads (height 1.680 m over a chin-to-crown head of 0.271 m, hair excluded; the bob reaches 1.680 m); coat hem 0.50 m above the floor; 2716 triangles over two primitives (VIS_body 1484, VIS_head 1232)

Head: scaled to the 6.2-head ratio, with a bob that hugs the skull by 1.5 cm, keeps its silhouette below the temples and flares to a level hem at the jawline, covers the nape to the collar and carries a side-swept fringe
Neck shortened by a 5 cm stand collar (1.343-1.393 m) and a 0.052 m neck radius, so almost no neck shows between the collar and the jaw

Limbs: sleeves 0.056 m at the shoulder tapering to 0.040 m at the wrist with a rounded shoulder cap in place of shoulder-pad geometry; straight trousers 0.068 m at the coat hem tapering to 0.050 m at the ankle; coat fuller at the hip with a gentle A-line hem
Feet: low loafer built from oval rings, 24 cm long, 7 cm high, standing on z = 0

Weights: spine chain by height with two-bone blends, rigid limbs with two-bone blends at elbows, knees, shoulders and hips, coat skirt pelvis + both thighs (50/50 at the hem with the near thigh taking over at the sides), tote bag on the pelvis and its strap blending pelvis to spine_03; normalised, top 4 influences
Flat vertex colours, no textures: #26324b coat, #e8dcc4 knit neckline, #a8a59a trousers, #2a2622 shoes, #cfa283 skin, #3b2a20 bob hair and brows, #2a2320 eyes, #9a5a4a mouth, #8a7a66 tote
VIS_head shape keys Basis, blinkLeft, blinkRight; each blink flattens its own eye ellipsoid to 10 percent of its height about the eye centre (52 vertices per eye)

Clips idle (4.0 s), walk (1.0 s), run (0.6 s) at 30 fps reused from the candidate A build: planar two-link leg IK, flat feet in stance, pelvis bob, arms adducted with opposite swing; this build lowers the walk crouch from 0.075 m to 0.025 m so the stance leg stays near straight
clip_authorship: Authored by GTEki contributors in Blender from code (no motion capture, no third-party clips); CC-BY-4.0
generator: tools/blender/character/build_commuter_soft.py, Blender 5.2.2 LTS (headless, -b) with the bundled glTF 2.0 exporter
budget: high tier: <=12000 triangles, <=3 primitives per visual node, <=1024^2 textures (0 used); this sample stays under 8000 triangles by design
